question: Who among the following is the author of the famous novel 'The adventures of Huckleberry Finn'?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Mark Twain**.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The** Adventures of Huckleberry Finn**, by American author Mark Twain, is a novel set in the pre-Civil War South
 
• It examines institutionalized racism and explores themes of freedom, civilization, and prejudice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7212d56a8ff8b67420fa575dfacc8bc0c9d13dfc910911c4815cf3a85d453cfc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ernest Hemingway**, is the american Novelist, a short story writer, and also a journalist of his time. 
 
• Emily Bronte,was an English novelist and poet who is best known for her only novel,** Wuthering Heights, **now considered a classic of English literature
 
• **Herman Melville**, is the American novelist and a poet of the renaissance,
